description: Turn one draft into a ready post for each platform (X, Bluesky, Threads, Mastodon, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Telegram, Discord): length counted the platform's way, hashtag caps, numbered thread split or word-boundary trim, warnings. Use before posting or scheduling the same message on several platforms, so nothing is cut off or rejected. Counts like each platform does (graphemes on Bluesky; weighted characters and 23-character links on X; 23-character links on Mastodon), applies hashtag caps (Instagram 5, Threads 1, YouTube 15), splits long text into a numbered thread where the platform has threads, otherwise trims at a word boundary. Returns input stats and results[] {platform, limit, length, fits, text, parts[], truncated, hashtags, hashtagsDropped[], warnings[]}. No AI rewriting; nothing is stored. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls, no wallet needed.

hashtags.description: Hashtags to append, with or without #; capped per platform

link.description: A link to append after the text

thread.description: Split long text into a thread where the platform has threads (default true); false trims instead

name: social_format

length.description: Length of the full composed post, counted the platform's way

parts.description: Thread parts in order (one when it fits)

text.description: The post to use: the full text when it fits, else the first thread part or the trimmed text

title: Social post formatter
